sources.title: FMM003 Teltonika Data Sending Parameters ID
FMM00A Teltonika Data Sending Parameters ID

fields.name: Ignition
fields.notes: Boolean state: 0 = off; 1 = on.

fields.name: Movement
fields.notes: Movement flag: 0 = stationary; 1 = moving.

fields.name: Data Mode
fields.notes: 0/1 = home stopped/moving; 2/3 = roaming stopped/moving; 4/5 = unknown network stopped/moving.

fields.name: GSM Signal
fields.notes: Signal-strength code, normally 1–5; this is not a dBm measurement.

fields.name: Sleep Mode
fields.notes: Sleep-state codes: 0 awake, 1 GPS sleep, 2 deep sleep, 3 online sleep, 4 ultra sleep.

fields.name: GNSS Status
fields.notes: GNSS codes: 0 off, 1 fix acquired, 2 searching without fix, 3 asleep.

fields.name: GNSS PDOP
fields.notes: Dilution-of-precision coefficient; smaller values indicate better geometry.

fields.name: GNSS HDOP
fields.notes: Horizontal dilution-of-precision coefficient.

fields.name: GSM Cell ID
fields.notes: Cell-tower identifier; not a physical measurement.

fields.name: GSM Area Code
fields.notes: Cellular location-area identifier; changes between network areas.

fields.name: Active GSM Operator
fields.notes: Serving operator code (MCC/MNC).

fields.name: Total Odometer
fields.notes: The description specifies metres even though the unit cell is blank.

fields.name: Fuel Used GPS
fields.notes: GPS-based cumulative fuel estimate; does not identify a CAN program.

fields.name: Fuel Rate GPS
fields.notes: GPS fuel estimate per distance (L/100km); this is not litres per hour or a CAN module ID.

fields.name: ICCID1
fields.notes: Most-significant part of the SIM ICCID; preserve as identifier text.

fields.name: SD Status
fields.notes: SD-card presence flag: 0 absent; 1 present.

fields.name: Dallas Temperature 1
fields.notes: Dallas errors (wire values): 850/5000 not ready, 2000 read failure, 3000 disconnected, 4000 ID failure. These values are not temperatures.

fields.name: Dallas Temperature 2
fields.notes: Dallas errors (wire values): 850/5000 not ready, 2000 read failure, 3000 disconnected, 4000 ID failure. These values are not temperatures.

fields.name: Dallas Temperature 3
fields.notes: Dallas errors (wire values): 850/5000 not ready, 2000 read failure, 3000 disconnected, 4000 ID failure. These values are not temperatures.

fields.name: Dallas Temperature 4
fields.notes: Dallas errors (wire values): 850/5000 not ready, 2000 read failure, 3000 disconnected, 4000 ID failure. These values are not temperatures.

fields.name: LLS 1 Fuel Level
fields.notes: LLS fuel-level reading; scale/choice of counts versus litres depends on sensor configuration. RS232/RS485.

fields.name: LLS 1 Temperature
fields.notes: LLS fuel temperature via RS232/RS485.

fields.name: LLS 2 Fuel Level
fields.notes: LLS fuel-level reading; scale/choice of counts versus litres depends on sensor configuration. RS485.

fields.name: LLS 2 Temperature
fields.notes: LLS fuel temperature via RS485.

fields.name: LLS 3 Fuel Level
fields.notes: LLS fuel-level reading; scale/choice of counts versus litres depends on sensor configuration. RS485.

fields.name: LLS 3 Temperature
fields.notes: LLS fuel temperature via RS485.

fields.name: LLS 4 Fuel Level
fields.notes: LLS fuel-level reading; scale/choice of counts versus litres depends on sensor configuration. RS485.

fields.name: LLS 4 Temperature
fields.notes: LLS fuel temperature via RS485.

fields.name: LLS 5 Fuel Level
fields.notes: LLS fuel-level reading; scale/choice of counts versus litres depends on sensor configuration. RS485.

fields.name: LLS 5 Temperature
fields.notes: LLS fuel temperature via RS485.

fields.name: Eco Score
fields.notes: Distance-based aggregate of driving-event occurrences; the table gives no physical unit.

fields.name: User ID
fields.notes: Bluetooth NMEA receiver MAC address; handle as an identifier.

fields.name: Network Type
fields.notes: Network codes: 0 3G, 1 GSM, 2 4G, 3 LTE Cat M1, 4 LTE Cat NB1, 99 unknown.

fields.name: Pulse Counter Din1
fields.notes: Pulse count resets on record storage.

fields.name: Pulse Counter Din2
fields.notes: Pulse count resets on record storage.

fields.name: BT Status
fields.notes: Bluetooth codes: 0 disabled, 1 enabled without connection, 2 Bluetooth v3 only, 3 BLE only, 4 both.

fields.name: ISO6709 Coordinates
fields.notes: Packed ISO6709 latitude/longitude/altitude; retain text, never chart as one scalar.

fields.name: Driver Name
fields.notes: Card-derived driver name; dollar-sign separators are removed.

fields.name: Driver card license type
fields.notes: Licence categories: 0 absent; 1–4 B.1–B.4; 5–8 T.1–T.4.

fields.name: Driver Gender
fields.notes: Gender codes in the source: 0 unspecified, 1 male, 2 female.

fields.name: Driver Card ID
fields.notes: The source repeats the gender description under Driver Card ID. Treat that description as an unresolved editorial error.

fields.name: Driver Card place of issue
fields.notes: Card-derived place-of-issue data.

fields.name: Driver Status Event
fields.notes: Card event: 0 registered, 1 deregistered, 2 swapping.

fields.name: MSP500 vendor name
fields.notes: Integrator identity.

fields.name: MSP500 vehicle number
fields.notes: Vehicle registration/number; identifier, not a measurement.

fields.name: Wake Reason
fields.notes: Flag indicating an RTC-alarm wake-up.

fields.name: EYE Pitch 1
fields.notes: Angle identity is stated, but the table leaves its unit blank; do not invent a degree scale.

fields.name: Auto Geofence
fields.notes: Automatic-geofence transition: 0 exit; 1 entry.

fields.name: Trip
fields.notes: Trip codes: 0 stop, 1 start. BT-app firmware 01.00.24+ also uses 2 business, 3 private, 4–9 custom.

fields.name: Over Speeding
fields.notes: Speed captured at the start/end of an overspeed event.

fields.name: Crash trace data
fields.notes: Encoded crash trace; retain as a composite value.

fields.name: Blood alcohol content
fields.notes: Packed alcohol reading: upper 14 bits carry per-mille ×1000; low 2 bits identify passive (0), active (1), or reserved (2–3) mode.

fields.name: Idling
fields.notes: Idle flag: 0 moving; 1 idling.

fields.name: Green driving type
fields.notes: Driving event: 1 acceleration; 2 braking; 3 cornering.

fields.name: Towing
fields.notes: Tow flag: 0 stable; 1 towing.

fields.name: Unplug
fields.notes: External-power presence: 0 connected; 1 unplugged.

fields.name: Crash detection
fields.notes: Crash code: 1 calibrated crash; 2 uncalibrated limited trace; 3 calibrated limited trace; 4 uncalibrated full trace; 5 calibrated full trace; 6 uncalibrated crash.

fields.name: Immobilizer
fields.notes: iButton status: 0 absent; 1 immobilizer connected; 2 authorized-driving connected.

fields.name: Green Driving Value
fields.notes: Event/configuration dependent: acceleration/braking uses raw/100 g; GPS cornering uses raw/100 rad/s; accelerometer cornering uses raw/100 g. No unconditional scalar unit.

fields.name: Jamming
fields.notes: Jamming transition: 0 ended; 1 started.

fields.name: ICCID2
fields.notes: Least-significant part of the SIM ICCID; preserve as identifier text.

fields.name: Green driving event duration
fields.notes: Duration of the triggering driving event.

fields.name: Alarm
fields.notes: Alarm code: 0 reserved; 1 triggered.

fields.name: EcoMaximum
fields.notes: Packed maximum acceleration: 2 zero bytes followed by signed 2-byte X/Y/Z values in mg. Not a single scalar.

fields.name: EcoAverage
fields.notes: Packed average acceleration: 2 zero bytes followed by signed 2-byte X/Y/Z values in mg. Not a single scalar.

fields.name: Driving State
fields.notes: Driving phase: 1 ignition on; 2 driving; 3 ignition off.

fields.name: Driving Records
fields.notes: Number of records within an ignition cycle.

fields.name: Crash event counter
fields.notes: Counter used to associate a trace with a crash event.

fields.name: GNSS Jamming
fields.notes: GNSS interference state: 0 healthy/ended; 1 warning; 2 critical.

fields.name: Private mode
fields.notes: Privacy flag: 0 disabled; 1 enabled.

fields.name: Ignition On Counter
fields.notes: Accumulated time with ignition on, in seconds; the name says counter.

fields.name: Motorcycle Fall Detection
fields.notes: Motorcycle fall event after configured conditions are satisfied.

fields.name: Short Fuel Trim
fields.notes: Short-term fuel trim for bank 1.

fields.name: MAF
fields.notes: Mass air flow: raw ×0.01 g/s.

fields.name: Fuel Type
fields.notes: 0=unavailable; 1=gasoline; 2=methanol; 3=ethanol; 4=diesel; 5=LPG; 6=CNG; 7=propane; 8=electric; 9=bifuel gasoline; 10=bifuel methanol; 11=bifuel ethanol; 12=bifuel LPG; 13=bifuel CNG; 14=bifuel propane; 15=bifuel electric; 16=bifuel electric/combustion; 17=hybrid gasoline; 18=hybrid ethanol; 19=hybrid diesel; 20=hybrid electric; 21=hybrid electric/combustion; 22=hybrid regenerative; 23=bifuel diesel.

fields.name: Commanded Equivalence R
fields.notes: Fuel/air commanded-equivalence ratio: raw ×0.01; dimensionless.

fields.name: Fault Codes
fields.notes: ASCII diagnostic codes separated by commas; Traccar emits space-separated dtcs.

fields.name: Fuel Rate
fields.notes: Engine fuel-flow rate: raw ×0.01 L/h.

fields.name: Calc Remaining Distance
fields.notes: Calculated remaining travel distance.

fields.name: OBD OEM Total Mileage
fields.notes: Vehicle-specific OEM PID for total distance; generic raw values are kilometres.

fields.name: OBD OEM Fuel Level
fields.notes: Vehicle-specific OEM PID for fuel volume; raw ×0.1 L.

fields.name: OEM Distance Until Service
fields.notes: Vehicle-specific distance remaining before service.

fields.name: OEM Remaining distance
fields.notes: Remaining range until fuel or EV battery is exhausted.

fields.name: ELD engine idle hours
fields.notes: Cumulative engine time spent idling.

fields.name: ELD Total Idle Fuel Used
fields.notes: Cumulative fuel consumed while idling.

fields.name: ELD Ambient Air Temperature
fields.notes: Source maximum 32768 exceeds signed 16-bit capacity; do not use it as a validated bound.

fields.name: ELD Engine Load
fields.notes: Absolute engine load based on intake-stroke air mass.

fields.name: ELD Oil Temperature
fields.notes: Source maximum 32768 exceeds signed 16-bit capacity; do not use it as a validated bound.

fields.name: ELD Oil Pressure
fields.notes: Gauge pressure in the engine oil circuit.

fields.name: ELD Engine Coolant Level
fields.notes: Coolant volume expressed as a percentage of cooling-system capacity.

fields.name: ELD Transmission Oil Temperature
fields.notes: Source maximum 32768 exceeds signed 16-bit capacity; do not use it as a validated bound.

fields.name: OEM HV Battery Min Cell Voltage
OEM HV Battery Max Cell Voltage
OEM HV Battery Min Cell Temperature
OEM HV Battery Max Cell Temperature
OEM HV Battery Lifetime Power Use
OEM HV Battery Lifetime Charge Power
OEM Fast Charge Count
fields.notes: Source says count but lists multiplier 0.1; preserve raw count pending clarification.

fields.name: OEM Slow Charge Count
fields.notes: Source says count but lists multiplier 0.1; preserve raw count pending clarification.

fields.name: Advanced BLE Beacon data
fields.notes: Composite advanced-mode beacon identifiers and payloads; no scalar conversion.

fields.name: BLE Temperature #1
fields.notes: Firmware 03.28.00+: wire errors 32767 missing, 32766 parse failure, 32765 sensor fault. Older firmware uses 3000/2000/4000 respectively; these overlap valid temperatures, so do not blanket-filter them.

fields.name: BLE Temperature #2
fields.notes: Firmware 03.28.00+: wire errors 32767 missing, 32766 parse failure, 32765 sensor fault. Older firmware uses 3000/2000/4000 respectively; these overlap valid temperatures, so do not blanket-filter them.
